name: Ethiopia Yirgacheffe
description: Bright and floral single-origin with notes of jasmine, bergamot, and lemon. Light roast, 12 oz bag.

name: Colombia Huila
description: A balanced, sweet medium roast with caramel and red apple notes. Our everyday crowd-pleaser.

name: Sumatra Mandheling
description: Earthy, full-bodied dark roast with cedar and dark chocolate. Low acidity and a long finish.

name: Ember House Espresso
description: Our signature espresso blend roasted for syrupy body, cocoa sweetness, and a hazelnut crema.

name: Midnight Decaf
description: Swiss Water Process decaf with notes of molasses and toasted almond. All flavor, no jitters.

name: Ceramic Pour-Over Dripper
description: Hand-glazed ceramic cone dripper with spiral ribs for an even, controlled extraction.

name: Gooseneck Kettle
description: Stainless steel kettle with a precision spout and built-in thermometer for perfect pours.

name: French Press, 34 oz
description: Double-walled steel French press that keeps coffee hot and brews rich, full-bodied cups.

name: Burr Hand Grinder
description: Conical steel burr grinder with 40 click settings, from espresso-fine to cold-brew coarse.

name: Cold Brew Jar
description: Glass jar with a fine mesh filter insert. Steep overnight for smooth, low-acid cold brew.

name: Speckled Stoneware Mug
description: A 12 oz handmade stoneware mug with a speckled cream glaze. Microwave and dishwasher safe.

name: Ember Logo Mug
description: Our classic 14 oz diner-style mug in deep ember red with the Ember & Bean flame logo.

name: Insulated Travel Tumbler
description: Vacuum-insulated 16 oz tumbler with a leakproof lid. Keeps coffee hot for 6 hours.

name: Espresso Cup Set
description: Set of four 3 oz porcelain demitasse cups with matching saucers. Perfect for a double shot.

name: Barista Gift Box
description: Two bags of seasonal beans, a stoneware mug, and a tasting journal, packed in a kraft gift box.
